input_resolution: 256x256 (benchmark); inputs of other sizes resized with Lanczos and outputs resized back
run_settings: official celeba.pt (Google-Drive release, 2021-10-18); test.py with the benchmark masks. A locally trained CTSDG model also exists (RelatedWorks/CTSDG/snapshots) but does not match the stored outputs; the official checkpoint reproduces them more closely (mean hole difference 3-8 vs 5-12 grey levels on 8 images)
evaluation: recomposited with Eq. (2); metrics per benchmark_v2/eval_pixel.py, eval_fid.py, eval_arcface.py
